text:
Carla: Heads up — deploy-bot flagged an embeddings quality regression in eu-dedicated during today's change window. p95 similarity down ~5% vs baseline; canary is at ~25% traffic. Pause/rollback? :warning:

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: Canary metrics for release v2.3.1-quant — embeddings_similarity: -5.1% (vs baseline), error_rate: 0.2% (steady), latency_p95: +120ms. Recommended action: ROLLBACK SUGGESTED. Triggered at 2025-03-12 16:03 UTC.

Mike: On it. Quick Qs — how many customers routed to eu-dedicated canary? Any active SLAs impacted?

Alice: We're seeing tail latency spike on pool eu-dedicated-3 and slight vm churn. Not huge errors but KV cache pressure up. Looks correlated with canary rollout window.

Ben: Confirmed — the canary applied q4 quantization profile to embeddings model (v2.3.1-quant). Similarity drop matches known edgecase for short-query distributions. If we rollback, we should pin to v2.3.0 (non-quant) and avoid auto-quant gate until we validate.

Carla: Decision: manual rollback to v2.3.0 for eu-dedicated. Manual because deploybot's auto-revert is suppressed during change window and we want release-notes + customer comms. Mike/Alice, please execute and confirm. I'll draft a brief customer note and update release notes. :white_check_mark:

Mike: Starting rollback now. Steps: 1) pin routing for eu-dedicated to model v2.3.0; 2) scale down v2.3.1-quant tasks; 3) ensure caches warmed on v2.3.0; 4) monitor similarity and latency. Executing commands: ```
# pin route
redwoodctl routes set --region eu --pool dedicated --model v2.3.0 --pin
# scale down canary
redwoodctl deploy scale --id deploy-eu-20250312 --target 0
```

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: Manual rollback initiated by @Mike. Canary traffic set to 0% for release v2.3.1-quant. Estimated rollback duration: 7-12 minutes. Posting hooks to observability.

Alice: pool eu-dedicated-3 rollback complete, tasks for v2.3.1-quant drained successfully. p95 latency back near baseline, embed similarity trending back up. Reinstituting steady-state monitors.

SRE-Oncall: Filed incident INC-20250312-emb-01 for tracking and postmortem. Please include the canary diff and quantization config. CC: legal if customer-facing SLAs may need notice.

Carla: Thanks all. I'll publish a short customer note: "We observed a temporary embeddings quality regression during a canary. We've rolled back to v2.3.0 and are monitoring. No data exposure. Investigating root cause and will follow up with timeline for re-release." Will also update the release notes and schedule a postmortem tomorrow. :memo:

Mike: Post-rollback sanity OK. Recommend blocking q4 quantization gate until we run a dedicated evaluation set across short-query slices and embeddings regression harness. Leaving the pin in place for 2 hours then reassess.

Ben: Agreed. I'll run the unit evals and push results into the eval dashboard. Thanks for the fast coord.

Carla: Closing thread for exec. If anything else pops in metrics, tag this thread and we reopen.
